e2_lr.reason: Input control: distinguish E2 signal from algorithm capacity.

e2_mlp.reason: Small nonlinear model; standardized Train-only E2, no automatic random early stopping.

e2_hist.reason: Compact single boosting model approximates E2 interactions without stacking/text branch.

e2_extra.reason: Randomized nonlinear tree ensemble as a different inductive bias, bounded depth/count.

selection: Within 1 MiB model+required data assets: mean AP descending, then mean recall at validation FPR budget descending, then total bytes ascending, then name. Export seed 42; never best-seed selection.
package_budget_status: research constraint, not agreed Android device budget
comparison_scope: all candidates same eligible Train/Validation, same targets, seeds, alpha; compare KD within family before comparing different inputs
threshold_scope: each seed/mode uses Validation FPR<=1%; fixed0.5 also reported

bootstrap.scope: conditional paired mean-seed score AP differences; excludes selection uncertainty

stopping_rule: No new candidates/grids after seeing this run. Finite predeclared budget, not global optimum.
